description: Create comprehensive logging system that captures all agent decisions, tool calls, retries, failures, and outputs in structured JSON format. Logs should prove autonomous operation, show decision-making process, track error recovery attempts, and provide audit trail. Extend existing .bowman/memory/sessions/ structure to generate agent_log.json format.

status.comment: Structured durable session memory and supervisor error logging exist. Felix must decide whether that satisfies the audit intent or whether a separate comprehensive agent_log.json—with its privacy, size, and retention tradeoffs—is still desired.

reflection: Status reconciliation on 2026-07-30 retained the existing implementation evidence and recognized that the only stated remainder is an explicit product/retention design decision, not a specified autonomous coding task.
